concern_summary: The search functionality of the chat finder page, encompassing the management of search results display, handling user interactions, and processing queries.
This concern addresses scenarios where the chat finder page leads to non-existent resources, providing fallback mechanisms and user navigation options in case of errors.
The functionalities related to managing chat reports and financial transactions, including tracking expenses and ensuring accurate reporting.
This concern manages approval rules and policy settings related to expense reports within the context of the chat finder page, allowing users to set limits and conditions for automatic approvals.
This concern allows for the selection and configuration of purchase bill dates, which is relevant for processing transactions within the chat finder context.
The functionalities that ensure proper management of chat reports, including retrieval, organization, and display of relevant information and actions.
This concern involves handling the display and editing of descriptions on the chat finder page, ensuring user input is validated and correctly managed based on the report type.
The functionalities that facilitate the creation and management of chat conversations, including generating reports for financial transactions associated with conversations.
The selection management aspect of the chat finder page, covering functionalities related to selecting items, states, countries, currencies, languages, and pronouns.
This concern handles user session management on the chat finder page, addressing session expiration and logout processes to ensure a smooth user experience.
